objective: Run one future, fail-closed, same-resource CPU cycle/traffic fast-kill for A1-SC8, A1-ISO8, A1-OSG and PBR4 on the exact H67 ep35 ConvTranspose S10 cohort. This source-only contract creates no result and authorizes no execution, RTL or paper claim.

future_launch_admission_must_pin: independent payload-verifier review and outer seal
exact 40-record member set and every payload SHA256

decoder_signed_int8_weight_input.source: A separately sealed H67 ep35 decoder signed-INT8 weight package whose tensor order is Cin,Cout,Ky,Kx and whose checkpoint/module identity matches M511.
decoder_signed_int8_weight_input.accumulator: signed Acc24 two's-complement wrap modulo 2^24 after every addition

descriptor_geometry.legality: destination coordinates must be inside the frozen layer output bounds

canonical_trace.zero_ordinal: emits no descriptor but emits one charged frontier handshake
canonical_trace.one_ordinal: emits every legal tap descriptor for the current output block and retires them before frontier advances
canonical_trace.block_close: all current-block descriptors, ingress, contexts, O8, pending writes, directory work and external commands retired; dense output fully accepted; directory clear

same_resource_coordinate.service: M218 6x16, one 96-lane source group issue per cycle, L4, O8, FIFO4, Acc24
same_resource_coordinate.external_link: one active command, 128 bytes per cycle, 32-cycle first-beat latency
same_resource_coordinate.join_contexts: four phase banks, four contexts per phase, 16x256bit total

final_output_address_and_payload.byte_mapping: global_byte=beat_index*128+byte_in_beat; if global_byte<288 then channel=floor(global_byte/3), channel_byte=global_byte mod 3; otherwise the byte is mandatory zero padding
final_output_address_and_payload.channel_encoding: signed Acc24 two's-complement, three bytes little-endian per channel
final_output_address_and_payload.aperture_proof: directory_index in 0..110399 implies vector and all three beat addresses are inside [0x20000000,0x30000000)

final_output_beat_protocol.shared_command_fields: valid1 opcode3 layer2 output_block2 destination20 tag24 time4 directory_index17 slice3 beats_remaining2 first_latency_counter6 generation8 direction1 reserved35
final_output_beat_protocol.beats_remaining2_encoding: 2-beat_index before the current beat is accepted; legal sequence 2,1,0
final_output_beat_protocol.advance_rule: beat_index increments only on outbound valid && sink_ready
final_output_beat_protocol.hold_rule: while valid && !sink_ready, opcode, owner identity, address, slice3, beats_remaining2, data and every command bit remain stable
final_output_beat_protocol.retirement: each beat retires exactly once on its outbound ready/valid handshake
final_output_beat_protocol.third_beat_semantics: accepted beat_index=2 is the only final-output transfer retirement event; the local command owner and generated address must match on that edge
final_output_beat_protocol.retry_semantics: backpressure is a hold, not a retry; no new request count and no duplicate beat is emitted
final_output_beat_protocol.duplicate_semantics: re-accepting an already retired beat for the same command identity is sticky fault and provides no completion credit
final_output_beat_protocol.response_mismatch_semantics: there is no inbound output response; local owner/address/beat mismatch on an accepted outbound beat is sticky fault
cursor_advance_requires: beat indices 0,1,2 accepted exactly once in order
beat_index 2 local owner and address match
final_output_beat_protocol.zero_output: six charged 48-byte zero-build cycles followed by the identical 32-cycle first latency and three accepted beats
final_output_beat_protocol.nonzero_output: six charged psum reads with L4 drain or charged restore, followed by the identical 32-cycle first latency and three accepted beats

source_scan_common_ledger.cycle_overlap_rule: the one semantic bit read and its frontier opportunity share the same dense-ordinal issue cycle; they are reported separately but added to total_cycles only once
source_scan_common_ledger.stall_rule: if the current ordinal cannot complete its required descriptor retire/frontier handshake, the scanner holds the same bit and ordinal; every hold cycle is charged as source_scan_frontier_stall and is not a new active read
source_scan_common_ledger.block_replay_rule: every output block starts ordinal zero and rereads the entire dense bitplane; no cross-block cached source word, bit or free Python array credit
forbidden: charging source replay only to a baseline
counting base source scan issue cycles twice
claiming modeled source energy before a common physical coefficient is sealed

phase_order: select and double-seal one fixed A1-STRONG
only then permit PBR4 construction and execution
baseline_selection_before_candidate_visi.selection_metric: minimum sum(total_cycles) over all 10 samples and all four layers
baseline_selection_before_candidate_visi.selection_receipt: baseline_selection.json plus member and outer SHA256 seals

functional_reference.canonical_accumulation: for each dense output destination and channel, add legal contributors in source_linear_ordinal then kernel_index order with signed Acc24 modulo-2^24 semantics

cycle_model.conservation: total_cycles equals sum of all mutually exclusive primary cycle classes

sink_ready_transcript.index: absolute simulated cycle from sample-layer epoch start
sink_ready_transcript.generator: xorshift32 with x0=0x53454217; x ^= x<<13; x ^= x>>17; x ^= x<<5, all modulo 2^32; ready is 0 iff low three bits are 000, otherwise 1

per_sample_per_layer_per_architecture: productive source and group issue cycles
weight refill requests, beats and bytes
psum SRAM reads, writes and bytes
persistent psum read and write commands, beats and bytes
final-output first-latency, accepted-beat and sink-stall cycles
directory query, set-RMW, clear-RMW and epoch-clear counts and cycles
resident hit, miss, eviction, restore and dirty-writeback counts
maximum occupancy of ingress, contexts, O8, FIFO4 and pending write
all modeled logical capacity items and total
descriptor, group, RMW, commit and output-data hashes
a1_only_preselection: per-sample and per-layer A1-SC8/A1-ISO8/A1-OSG total cycles
aggregate: per-sample speedup and minimum per-sample speedup
all traffic byte sums by architecture and memory class
source scan common-ledger equality across all four points
weight active-read and refill-byte candidate-minus-baseline deltas
modeled dynamic energy symbolic term totals and reduction percent only if common numeric coefficients are separately admitted
all function and conservation mismatch totals
A1-OSG versus PBR4 group, RMW and commit sequence equivalence verdict
modeled logical capacity 239636 bytes and foundry/CACTI/PPA false labels

go_requires_all: every sample sum(A1-STRONG layer cycles)/sum(PBR4 layer cycles) >= 1.10
PBR4 weight active reads do not exceed A1-STRONG
PBR4 weight refill bytes do not exceed A1-STRONG
no extra port, bandwidth, state or capacity
PBR4 group/RMW/commit sequence is not equivalent to A1-OSG
decision_gate.support_only: If speed gates fail but PBR4 reduces psum read-plus-write bytes by at least 30 percent under the same ledger, retain only as decoder support or traffic ablation.
decision_gate.kill: Any function/conservation mismatch, hidden resource, baseline oracle, weight-traffic increase, A1-OSG equivalence, or failure of both performance and 30-percent psum-traffic gates kills RTL promotion.

next_gate.after_static_pass: Author an exact runner source and a separate launch admission that binds the then-present M511 payload, signed-INT8 decoder weight package, runner SHA and result absence.
